items.title: New ‘Chicago’ star Reece Weaver shares her ‘game-changer’ hack for long-lasting makeup
items.description: From her time as a Dallas Cowboys cheerleader to her new Broadway role, Weaver knows how to keep her glam game strong.
items.articleText: Shopping exclusive New ‘Chicago’ star Reece Weaver shares her ‘game-changer’ hack for long-lasting makeup By Victoria McDonnell Published Aug. 12, 2026, 12:56 p.m. ET Reece Weaver knows a thing or two about game-changing beauty buys. reece_christinee/Instagram; Courtesy See more of our coverage in your search results. Add Page Six on Google Page Six may be compensated and/or receive an affiliate commission if you click or buy through our links. Featured pricing is subject to change. Reece Weaver is trading in her cowboy boots for Broadway — and she’s bringing her signature glam along for the ride. The former DCC cheerleader has always seemed destined for stardom, whether she’s doing her infamous jump splits, posting flower arranging videos on Instagram or teaching a cheer combo dance class wearing a Halara exercise dress from her own collection . And this week, she announced she’ll be joining the cast of “Chicago” as Roxie Hart, succeeding Whitney Leavitt in the acclaimed production. So with all that dancing on her agenda, we had to know how she keeps her glam looking flawless. “My biggest tip for long-lasting makeup is to use setting spray throughout your entire makeup routine, not just at the end,” she told Page Six Style, naming One/Size’s On ’Til Dawn Setting Spray and Charlotte Tilbury’s Airbrush Flawless Setting Spray as her favorites. One/Size On ’Til Dawn Setting Spray Sephora SEPHORA $34.00 Charlotte Tilbury Airbrush Flawless Setting Spray Charlotte Tilbury AMAZON $39.00 “I like to lightly mist my face after different steps of my application, and I’ve found that layering setting spray this way helps lock everything in,” she added, calling the hack a “game-changer for keeping my makeup looking fresh, sweat-resistant and smudge-proof all day.” When it comes to the rest of her makeup bag, Weaver also has her go-to lineup down to a science. She tells us her “top five favorite” products include Charlotte Tilbury Airbrush Flawless Finish Powder , Dibs Beauty GlowTour Duo and Rare Beauty Harmony Eyebrow Gel , plus Tarte’s CC Under-Eye Color Corrector and Maracuja Juicy Lip Liner . Tarte Maracuja Juicy Lip Liner in Dusty Rose Sephora SEPHORA $23.00 Weaver is succeeding Whitney Leavitt as Roxie in the acclaimed production. reece_christinee/Instagram For hair, she keeps things equally practical with products like the the Living Proof Heat Styling Spray , Hairitage Texture Spray and Kenra Professional Volume Spray — especially given her history of performing under serious stage lights and game-day conditions. “I always planned my hair wash schedule around game day,” she said of her time as a pro cheerleader. “I would wash my hair about two days beforehand because I’ve found that slightly ‘lived-in’ hair holds products and curls so much better.” Living Proof Perfect Hair Day Heat Styling Spray Sephora AMAZON $34.00 Kenra Professional Volume Spray Amazon AMAZON $22.00 Now, as a professional dancer preparing for Broadway, Weaver is also keeping her skin care regime streamlined. “I try to keep my skin care routine simple and consistent,” she said. “I always start with a gentle cleanser — I love ZO Skincare’s Gentle Cleanser because it cleans my skin without stripping away moisture.” Her beauty shelf is a mix of hardworking staples and high-tech tools, also including favorites like the ZO Skin Complexion Renewal Pads , CurrentBody Skin Red Light Mask and Charlotte Tilbury’s Magic Serum and Magic Cream . ZO Skin Gentle Cleanser ZO Skin ZO SKIN $50.00 ZO Skin Complexion Renewal Pads ZO Skin ZO SKIN $63.00 As for her biggest skincare tip, however? “Drink lots of water! Staying hydrated makes such a difference in keeping my skin healthy and glowing from the inside out.” Below, shop more of her beauty must-haves. After all, from football fields to Broadway stages, Weaver clearly knows how to keep her glam game strong. items.title: Paris Jackson details unconventional first meeting with mom Debbie Rowe at age 15
items.description: The 28-year-old also opened up about her super secretive childhood with dad Michael Jackson on the "Call Her Daddy" podcast Wednesday.
items.articleText: Parents Paris Jackson details unconventional first meeting with mom Debbie Rowe at age 15 By Riley Cardoza Published Aug. 12, 2026, 12:04 p.m. ET See more of our coverage in your search results. Add Page Six on Google Paris Jackson described the moment she casually met her mom, Debbie Rowe, for the first time at age 15. “I remember coming downstairs and she was in the living room with my grandma,” the 28-year-old told “Call Her Daddy” listeners on Wednesday. “I came in and I was just like, ‘Hey, Mom.'” Jackson confirmed host Alex Cooper’s question that she did “right away” refer to Rowe, 67, as mom. 9 Paris Jackson described the moment she met her mom, Debbie Rowe, at age 15. paris jackson/ instagram 9 “I remember coming downstairs and she was in the living room with my grandma,” the singer told “Call Her Daddy” listeners Wednesday. Call Her Daddy/Youtube Explore More Paris Jackson lifts lid on super secretive childhood with dad Michael ‘Jackass: Best and Last’ premiere red carpet: Pedro Pascal, Paris Jackson, Johnny Knoxville and more How latest change in Michael Jackson’s estate could impact Paris’ fight to take back control Rowe, notably, gave birth to her and Michael Jackson’s daughter — and their now-29-year-old son, Prince — in 1997 and 1998, respectively. The nurse and the King of Pop divorced in 2000, with the latter getting full custody of the kids. During the mother-daughter meetup, Paris recalled, “I sat down, we talked for a second and then we went out for the day and just, like, hung out.” 9 At the time, the model said, “Hey, Mom.” Call Her Daddy/Youtube 9 The duo “talked for a second and then we went out for the day and just, like, hung out.” / SplashNews.com Want more celebrity and pop culture news? Start your day with Page Six Daily. Thanks for signing up! Enter your email address Please provide a valid email. By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy . Want celebrity news as it breaks? Check out more newsletters As for their connection, Paris explained, “She’s a [Sagittarius], so she’s got the fire. And I’m an Aries, so I’ve got the fire. We’re very similar.” The model clarified that she has learned how “expectations [can] f–k us up,” so she walked into that relationship — and others in her life — without them. That way, Paris said, she doesn’t “end up maybe being disappointed or frustrated or irritated, or a resentment will be born or something.” 9 Jackson said she and her mom are “very similar” due to their star signs. paris jackson/ instagram 9 Jackson (pictured above in March 2019) went into the relationship knowing that “expectations [can] f–k [things] up.” Chelsea Lauren / Shutterstock The singer noted, “When I walk into something and I don’t have expectations, it creates this really cool space for something organic to just blossom.” Paris’ mindset in this area has become “more refined” over the years. Reports surfaced in 2013 that Paris was “bonding” with her mom — and the pair made headlines for sharing a rare selfie together earlier this year. 9 Without those, she was able to create a “really cool space for something organic to just blossom.” paris jackson/ instagram 9 Rowe (pictured above in December 1998) was married to Michael Jackson between 1996 and 2000. Getty Images 9 The pair (pictured above in 1997) welcomed Paris and son Prince during their time together, with the King of Pop going on to have son Bigi via surrogate. WireImage While Paris did not elaborate further on their connection Wednesday, she did give rare insight into her super secretive childhood with Michael, Prince and younger brother Bigi, now 24. The actress explained why wearing masks while out in public “made sense” — so the siblings could “go to Chuck E. Cheese and be normal” — and noted they were not allowed to watch TV except on weekends after doing chores and homework. She called her late father, who died in 2009 at 50, a “really funny guy,” referring to herself as the Grammy winner’s “little princess.” Filed under celebrity children celebrity families celebrity interviews celebrity moms debbie rowe paris jackson podcasts 8/12/26 Read Next Matthew McConaughey and wife Camila Alves make rare appear... items.title: ‘Great British Baking Show’ alum Prue Leith, 86, rushed to the hospital after losing sight and speech
items.description: Leith said her "incomprehensible jumble of disconnected words" convinced her husband, John, that she was having a stroke.
items.articleText: Celebrity News ‘Great British Baking Show’ alum Prue Leith, 86, rushed to the hospital after losing sight and speech By Eric Todisco Published Aug. 12, 2026, 11:54 a.m. ET Former “The Great British Baking Show” judge Prue Leith revealed she was hospitalized after losing her sight and speech. “A few weeks ago, staying in Yorkshire, I had a migraine attack,” the 86-year-old wrote in her column Prue’s News in the September issue of The Oldie magazine, which is out on Friday, according to The Sun . Leith said she lost “half” of her vision before “a bright circle of flickering, colored lights” appeared in the upper right field of her eyesight. 6 Prue Leith (seen above) revealed she was hospitalized “a few weeks ago” after losing her sight and speech. Ken McKay/ITV/Shutterstock 6 The former “Great British Baking Show” said she suffered an extreme migraine and was rushed to the hospital in Yorkshire. Kristin Callahan/Shutterstock Explore More Tom Segura breaks silence on ‘horrible’ Christina Pazsitzky divorce Chrissy Metz reveals GLP-1 use after 100-lb weight loss: See pics ‘The Office’ star reveals terminal cancer diagnosis, details plan to ‘live out whatever might be left of my life’ The reality star told her husband, John Playfair, that she was only having a migraine, but her “incomprehensible jumble of disconnected words” convinced him that she was suffering a stroke. “He rang our doctor, who asked me, could I raise my arms? Yes. Make a fist? Yes. Did anything hurt? No. Was the side of my face drooping,” Leith remembered, noting that “in spite of my answers,” an ambulance was ordered to take her to the hospital. Leith said after a six-hour wait, she saw a doctor who decided Leith needed a CT scan. “Two hours later, I had one, waited another hour for the results, and was released at 2 a.m.,” she added. 6 Leith said her “incomprehensible jumble of disconnected words” convinced her husband, John Playfair (both seen above at London Fashion Week 2026), that she was having a stroke. Getty Images 6 Leith (pictured here at the 2026 Wimbledon Tennis Championships) got a CT scan at the hospital and was released at 2 AM. Getty Images Stay one step ahead with all the exclusive tea on your favorite reality TV stars! Sign up for Virtual Reali-Tea with Danny and Evan, our must-read newsletter! Thank for signing up! Enter your email address Please provide a valid email. By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy . Want more celebrity and pop culture news? Check out more newsletters Leith confirmed the results showed she had a severe migraine attack, but is happy the doctors treated her under the assumption she was having a stroke. “I knew all along that all I had was a migraine. But since the speech problem is a classic symptom of a stroke, and my extreme old age being a time when mini-strokes are common, everyone was determined to be safe not sorry,” she wrote. Leith previously opened up about her health issues when she appeared on “Loose Women” in April 2025. “Age stinks, come on, it takes me 10 minutes to get myself out of bed in the morning. If I don’t do my exercises, I can’t move,” she said at the time. The former Netflix star also admitted that since she’s become “conscious” that the “end” of her life is near, she wants to “make the most of it and have fun.” 6 Leith (seen above with fellow judge Paul Hollywood) confirmed the medical results showed she had a migraine. Channel Four 6 Leith (seen here with Hollywood and contestant Alice Fevronia) thanked the hospital for taking the necessary precautions when they treated her. Channel Four/Courtesy Everett Collection Leith was a judge on “The Great British Baking Show” for nine years before announcing her exit from the series in January. “Bake Off has been a fabulous part of my life for the last nine years, I have genuinely loved it, and I’m sure I’ll miss working with my fellow judge Paul, Alison and Noel and the teams at Love Productions and Channel 4,” she said in a statement. Leith added that it feels like “the right time” for her to step away, noting, “I’m 86 for goodness sake!” Chef Nigella Lawson is replacing Leith for the Netflix show’s next season, which is expected to premiere in the US in September. items.description: The "Bodak Yellow" rapper was joined by Teyana Taylor for a night of dancing and cocktails at Aura 57 NYC last Friday night.
items.articleText: Society Cardi B clubs with Teyana Taylor, Chris Noth restaurant repeats and more sightings By Leah Bitsky Published Aug. 12, 2026, 11:51 a.m. ET See more of our coverage in your search results. Add Page Six on Google Celebrities swept the city last week. Cardi B hosted a private party at Midtown nightclub, Aura 57 NYC, last Friday night. The rapper was joined by close pal Teyana Taylor as they danced and sipped on bottles of Don Julio 1942 Tequila. Cardi was seen twerking while wearing a pair of skin-tight blue pants with revealing lace-up details along her backside, paired with a white crop top and a pink Hermès Mini Kelly. 8 Cardi B partied at Aura 57 NYC last Friday (seen above). @shareifz / BACKGRID 8 The rapper was joined by Teyana Taylor at the exclusive celebration (seen above). @shareifz / BACKGRID Explore More Brooks Nader says you ‘can’t go wrong’ with these $40 jeans that ‘complement the body so perfectly’ ‘Snatched’ Cardi B sets record straight on butt-reduction rumors: ‘I’m comfortable in my skin’ Cardi B’s waist-whittling corset needs to be seen to be believed The “One Battle After Another” actress wore a black sheer cold-shoulder catsuit. Last Wednesday, Chris Noth and New York Yankees legend Reggie Jackson were spotted dining at Serafina 61. 8 Cardi (seen at the party Friday) wore a white crop top and blue pants. @shareifz / BACKGRID 8 Other A-listers at the event (seen above) included Lil Baby and Meek Mill. @shareifz / BACKGRID We’re told the “Sex and the City” alum also dined at Serafina earlier this week, where he enjoyed a special meal prepared by the restaurant’s founder, Fabio Granato. On behalf of Angry Orchard, the retired first baseman showed up as a surprise stand-in player for the Sons of Pitches, a team that was on a 14-game losing streak. “I’ve played in front of packed stadiums, in playoff games and in high-stakes moments with a lot on the line,” Swisher said in a press release. “And every athlete knows the feeling of a tough loss. But if you’re going to have a rough season, the least you can do is have some fun with it. 8 The former Yankee visited on behalf of Angry Orchard (seen above). AP Content Services for Angry Orchard “That’s what I loved about this team and what Angry Orchard celebrates: finding the good times, even when the scoreboard isn’t on your side,” he added. That’s why we sent in Angry Orchard Super Sub Nick Swisher to surprise a team that never let a tough season get in the way of having fun.” Filed under cardi b chris noth new york yankees teyana taylor 8/12/26 Read Next Gayle King gifts Powerball tickets to 'CBS Mornings' and '... items.title: ‘Chicago P.D.’ star calls out modeling agency for pointing out body parts where she needed to ‘lose weight’ at 17
items.description: Tracy Spiridakos recalled that she was "so excited" to get into modeling, but the body-shaming incident deterred her from pursuing that career.
items.articleText: Celebrity News ‘Chicago P.D.’ star calls out modeling agency for pointing out body parts where she needed to ‘lose weight’ at 17 By Eric Todisco Published Aug. 12, 2026, 11:39 a.m. ET See more of our coverage in your search results. Add Page Six on Google “Chicago P.D.” star Tracy Spiridakos revealed a modeling agency once circled her “body flaws” and told her to lose weight at age 17. Spiridakos recalled on Monday’s episode of the “I’ve Never Said This Before” podcast that after winning a modeling contest, one of her brothers took her to a meeting at a modeling agency, where she was told to put on a bikini for a photoshoot. “I went, I put the bikini on, I came out and they took Polaroid pictures of me and then laid them out in front of me, and took a Sharpie and circled all my body flaws and laid them out and they said, ‘You have to lose weight here, here, and here if you want to do this,'” she shared. 8 “Chicago P.D.” star Tracy Spiridakos (seen above) recalled being body shamed by a modeling agency when she was 17. I've Never Said This Before with Tommy DiDario/ Youtube 8 Spiridakos said the agency circled her “body flaws” with a Sharpie and told her to lose weight. I've Never Said This Before with Tommy DiDario/ Youtube Explore More Kate Beckinsale scrubs social media after eviscerating body-shaming comments labeling her ‘anorexic or on meth’ Chrissy Metz gives candid ‘progress report’ after GLP-1 announcement ‘Unrecognizable’ John Goodman, 74, shocks fans with 200-pound weight loss in new candid photo Spiridakos, now 38, said she felt “deflated” in the moment and “didn’t really know what to say,” while her brother “got defensive” about the body shaming. The agents, according to Spiridakos, told the pair, “She’s pretty for guy-meets-girl kind of pretty, but if she wants to make it in this industry, she’s got to lose weight.” That comment “was like a gut punch” for Spiridakos, who explained how “excited” she was to get into modeling. 8 Spiridakos (pictured above at the 2023 Monte Carlo TV Festival) admitted she felt “deflated” in the moment. WireImage 8 Spiridakos (seen here at an event in May) claimed the agents told her she needed to “lose weight” if she wanted to “make it in this industry.” Getty Images for Alliance for Women in Media Foundation Want more celebrity and pop culture news? Start your day with Page Six Daily. Thanks for signing up! Enter your email address Please provide a valid email. By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy . Want celebrity news as it breaks? Check out more newsletters “And they were a pretty big agency,” Spiridakos added before admitting she couldn’t remember the company’s name. The “Bates Motel” star and her brother “walked out” of the meeting, after which he consoled her and told her, “You’re not modeling anymore. I’m telling mom you’re done.” Spiridakos admitted the incident left a lasting impact on her. 8 Spiridakos (seen here on Aug. 5) and her brother “walked out” of the meeting before she decided she was done with modeling. Getty Images 8 The actress (seen above in “Chicago P.D”) said she couldn’t remember the name of the agency, which she said was “pretty big.” Lori Allen/NBC via Getty Images “It’s funny, because, those places on my body that they circled, even now — and it’s been a long time — I still see those things in the mirror,” she explained. “I see those flaws, even though they’re not flaws, because you’re at such a young age and so impressionable at 17. And I have to tell myself that that is not real. And to just love yourself and to not care.” Spiridakos added, “Don’t let anyone tell you how to live in your own body.” 8 Spiridakos (seen here in the NBC show) admitted the body-shaming incident affected her permanently. Lori Allen/NBC via Getty Images 8 “I have to tell myself that that is not real. And to just love yourself and to not care,” she said. Lori Allen/NBC via Getty Images About a year or two after that day at the modeling agency, Spiridakos landed her first on-screen role in a 2007 episode of “Supernatural.” Her first major role was in the 2012 NBC series “Revolution,” for which she was nominated for a Saturn Award. In 2017, Spiridakos began playing Detective Hailey Upton in “Chicago P.D.” She left the show in 2024, but returned for a guest appearance earlier this year. items.description: The 53-year-old announced via Instagram on Tuesday that she is battling "Stage 4 Breast Cancer, which has metastasized to [her] bones.”
items.articleText: Celebrity News Cancer survivor Jenna Fischer sends love to fellow ‘Office’ star Lucy Davis after terminal diagnosis By Riley Cardoza Published Aug. 12, 2026, 11:22 a.m. ET See more of our coverage in your search results. Add Page Six on Google Lucy Davis got love from her fellow “Office” actress Jenna Fischer after going public with her terminal cancer diagnosis . Fischer, a breast cancer survivor , commented on Davis’ “beautiful post” via Instagram on Tuesday. “Love you lots,” Fischer, who played Pam Beesly in the U.S. version of the show, wrote before co-signing Davis’ decision to continue “working with cancer.” 8 Jenna Fischer (pictured above in 2005) reacted to Lucy Davis’ cancer diagnosis on Tuesday. WireImage 8 The 52-year-old, best known for her role in the original “Office” series, went public with her health news via Instagram. BBC Explore More ‘The Office’ alum Jenna Fischer flashes a smile in LA after revealing grueling battle with cancer ‘The Office’ star Jenna Fischer reveals breast cancer diagnosis, details grueling treatment Jenna Fischer and Angela Kinsey launching podcast on ‘The Office’ She gushed, “Let’s spread that message far and wide! How working is such a comfort.” Fischer, notably, was diagnosed with Stage 1 breast cancer in December 2023 — and confirmed the following year that she is cancer-free after a lumpectomy, 12 rounds of chemotherapy and one week of radiation. Davis, meanwhile, told her followers on Tuesday that her Stage 4 breast cancer, which she was diagnosed with a year and a half ago, “metastasized to [her] bones.” 8 Fischer, who acted in the American version of the show, commented on the “beautiful post.” NBCU Photo Bank/NBCUniversal via Getty Images 8 “Love you lots,” the actress (pictured above in 2025) wrote. msjennafischer/Instagram Want more celebrity and pop culture news? items.title: Meghan Markle suffers awkward exchange with David Foster in viral video
items.description: "This was soooo obvious," one social media user commented of the tense exchange.
items.articleText: Royal Family Meghan Markle suffers awkward exchange with David Foster in viral video By Jolie Zenna Published Aug. 12, 2026, 11:15 a.m. ET See more of our coverage in your search results. Add Page Six on Google Meghan Markle was “snubbed” by David Foster in a viral red carpet moment. Markle and her husband, Prince Harry, attended the 40th anniversary gala for the David Foster Foundation in Victoria, Canada, on Friday. In footage circulating on social media, the Duke and Duchess of Sussex both greeted the Grammy winner on the carpet and Markle even reached out her arm to him — but Foster walked straight past her. However, Foster did appear to acknowledge Harry, giving him a smile. 8 Meghan Markle was “snubbed” by David Foster on the carpet of the 40th anniversary gala for the David Foster Foundation Friday. thezonefm/Facebook 8 In a viral clip, the Duchess of Sussex greeted the Grammy winner on the carpet, reaching her out her arm to him — but Foster walked straight past her. thezonefm/Facebook TENSIONS on the red carpet! Meghan Markle publicly snubbed by host David Foster. Watch as he refuses to greet her and ignores her reaching hand. Ouch pic.twitter.com/Um02lbAYNG — Paula Matanovich © (@paulamatanovich) August 8, 2026 Explore More How a 74-minute collection of online cat videos beat an Anthony Bourdain biopic and Meghan and Harry’s cookie doc Fresh blow to Harry and Meghan as their Girl Scout cookie doc crumbles, is beaten by compilation of cat videos at box office Meghan Markle wears Princess Diana’s diamond and sapphire earrings on date night with Prince Harry Foster’s wife, Katherine McPhee, followed soon after her husband and proceeded to stand next to Markle. The two couples then posed for a photo, with the two men standing on the outside. As the foursome smiled for the cameras, Harry and Foster shared a short exchange and a laugh, but Foster appeared to direct his words toward Harry alone. “TENSIONS on the red carpet! Meghan Markle publicly snubbed by host David Foster. Watch as he refuses to greet her and ignores her reaching hand. Ouch,” the user who originally shared the clip wrote in the caption. Social media users in the comments section agreed that Foster’s move looked intentional. 8 The legendary songwriter appeared to just acknowledge Prince Harry. thezonefm/Facebook 8 Foster and his wife, Katherine McPhee, proceeded to take a photo with the couple, though Foster and Markle seem to still not interact. thezonefm/Facebook “He totally ghosted her but did acknowledge Harry,” one wrote. “This was soooo obvious,” another added. However, others argued that it was an innocent exchange. “What’s wrong about this, she’s so kind giving a space for picture taking, where’s the snub?????” one questioned. A second wrote, “He walked by her as she was guiding him politely to take a photo. lol wtf is wrong with you people?” Page Six has reached out to reps for Foster and Markle for comment. 8 Many social media users agreed that Foster appeared to intentionally snub the actress. The David Foster Foundation via Getty Images 8 Markle and Harry have been friends with both Foster and McPhee for years. The David Foster Foundation via Getty Images Want more celebrity and pop culture news? Start your day with Page Six Daily. Thanks for signing up! Enter your email address Please provide a valid email. By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy . Want celebrity news as it breaks? Check out more newsletters Harry and Markle have been friends with Foster and McPhee for years. Harry, 41, and Foster, 76, are known to have a close “father and son” bond — especially since Harry has been estranged from his own family. Back in 2020, McPhee gushed over her husband’s “beautiful” friendship with the “Spare” author. “My husband has a really, really beautiful relationship with Harry,” McPhee told Access Hollywood at the time. “They’re so cute, they’re like father and son. We just stay in touch with them.” That same year, it was reported that the legendary songwriter helped set up Harry and Meghan’s access to a multimillion-dollar Canadian compound after the couple relinquished their titles as senior members of the royal family. 8 Back in 2020, the “American Idol” alum gushed over her husband’s “father and son” bond with the “Spare” author. The David Foster Foundation via Getty Images 8 Foster also reportedly helped Harry and Markle find a new home after they stepped back from the royal family. The David Foster Foundation via Getty Images “David’s the resource guy, he knows all the places. He loves to help people so we just hope they end up somewhere where they feel like they can really just settle down,” McPhee said of the arrangement. Additionally, Markle and the “American Idol” alum have known each other since childhood. “She went to a school called Immaculate Heart, as did I,” McPhee said of Markle during the 2020 interview. “She went there for middle school and high school, and I went there just for middle school. My sister was in her class, my sister was in middle school with her, and I was in middle school when she was in high school, so I did a couple shows with her.” Filed under celebrity friendships david foster katharine mcphee meghan markle prince harry red carpet viral videos 8/12/26 Read Next Meghan Markle wears Princess Diana's diamond and sapphire ... items.title: John Hinckley Jr. sends message to Jodie Foster 45 years after infamous Ronald Reagan assassination attempt
items.description: Hinckley Jr. famously shot and almost killed Reagan to impress Foster after watching her in "Taxi Driver."
items.articleText: Celebrity News John Hinckley Jr. sends message to Jodie Foster 45 years after infamous Ronald Reagan assassination attempt By Eric Todisco Published Aug. 12, 2026, 10:32 a.m. ET See more of our coverage in your search results. Add Page Six on Google John Hinckley Jr. sent well wishes to Jodie Foster 45 years after shooting President Ronald Reagan to impress the actress. “I just wish Jodie Foster well, you know,” Hinckley Jr., 71, said in Entertainment Weekly’s preview clip of his interview on “The Mark Joseph Show” airing Wednesday He added, “I don’t really see her movies, but I wish her well, and I know she’s doing quite well. And that’s all I can say is just, I wish Jodie well, and I hope she has a good life.” 9 John Hinckley Jr. (seen above in 2023) shared a message for Jodie Foster 45 years after shooting Ronald Reagan to impress the actress. TNS 9 Hinckley said, “I just wish Jodie Foster well, you know” (Foster is seen above at the 2025 New York Film Festival). Getty Images for FLC Explore More Jodie Foster, 63, seen walking with a cane during rare outing with wife Alexandra Hedison ‘Silence of the Lambs’ star Ted Levine apologizes for legendary villain role after transgender criticism Jodie Foster reveals ‘challenging’ process of prepping for French-speaking role Page Six has reached out to Foster’s rep for comment. On March 30, 1981, Hinckley Jr. tried to assassinate Reagan as the then-president left the Hilton Hotel in Washington DC, as a way of impressing Foster after becoming obsessed with her from watching “Taxi Driver.” Reagan suffered serious injuries during the assassination attempt, including a punctured lung and a broken rib. The .22 caliber bullet had narrowly missed his heart. The attack injured three others, including former White House press secretary James Brady, who became permanently paralyzed. He later died in 2014. 9 Hinckley Jr. shot Reagan on March 30, 1981 when the president let the Hilton Hotel in Washington, DC. Getty Images 9 Reagan was injured in the shooting but survived, while press secretary James Brady (seen above) was permanently paralyzed. Circa Images/Glasshouse Images Hinckley Jr. was found not guilty by reason of insanity in 1982 and spent over 34 years committed at St. Elizabeth’s Hospital. He was released in 2022. On the podcast, Hinckley Jr. revealed to Joseph — who directed the 2024 film “Reagan” starring Dennis Quaid as the late president — what his goal for the shooting was. “I wanted to have a union with Jodie Foster and live the rest of my life with her and all these things that, of course, were delusional,” he explained. “But I was believing those things at the time, so the best outcome would have been a union with Jodie Foster.” 9 Hinckley Jr. said he hopes Foster (seen above in 2025) “has a good life.” Getty Images 9 Hinckley Jr. (whose mugshot is seen above) explained his goal for the shooting was to get married to Foster. Getty Images 9 Hinckley Jr. also said he figured he’d go to jail, but hoped Foster would still end up with him (Reagan is pictured above). CONSOLIDATED NEWS PICTURES/AFP via Getty Images Want more celebrity and pop culture news? Start your day with Page Six Daily. Thanks for signing up! Enter your email address Please provide a valid email. By clicking above you agree to the Terms of Use and Privacy Policy . Want celebrity news as it breaks? Check out more newsletters After Joseph noted that Mark David Chapman went to jail for fatally shooting John Lennon in 1980, Hinckley Jr. explained that while he figured he’d be locked up, he hoped he’d still end up with Foster. “I thought she would, you know, after things settled down, join me wherever I was,” he shared. “I wasn’t sure if I was gonna be in jail or the hospital or what after things settled down. I had this notion that she was gonna join me wherever I was.” Foster, now 63, told People in 2024 how the assassination attempt on Reagan impacted her life. 9 Foster (seen here) has opened up about how the shooting has impacted her life. Getty Images 9 Hinckley Jr. (seen here) spent over 34 years committed at St. Elizabeth’s Hospital before he was released in 2022. Bettmann Archive “The world fell apart, there were Secret Service people everywhere, I had bodyguards, and I had to be taken to a safe house,” she recalled. The “Silence of the Lambs” actress also revealed that while performing in a play shortly after the shooting, a guy sitting in the front row brought a gun to the show. “It was a traumatic moment,” she said, “and I’ve never admitted that maybe that has something to do with how I never wanted to do a play again. It was all part of that.” Filed under actors assassination jodie foster john hinckley jr. ronald reagan shootings 8/12/26 Read Next Matthew McConaughey and wife Camila Alves make rare appear...
